brief:
Israeli opposition parties have called for an investigation into allegations that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office attempted to frame Arab political parties, Al Jazeera English reported. The accusation centers on reports that Netanyahu's team sought to manipulate or fabricate evidence against Arab lawmakers.

Opposition figures characterized the alleged conduct as a "coup," suggesting a fundamental breach of democratic norms. The calls for investigation mark an escalation in tensions between Netanyahu and his political rivals over governance and institutional integrity.
dek: Rivals call for investigation into reports that PM's office tried to frame Arab parties.
title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of coup attempt
